title: Skin Pack Manifest
description: The manifest.json file for a Minecraft Bedrock Edition skin pack. Skin packs contain custom player skins that can be applied in-game. The manifest identifies the pack and its contents.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of this manifest file. Use 1 or 2.

header.title: Header
header.description:
The header section containing the pack's identity: name, description, unique UUID, and version.

Properties:
• modules
• dependencies

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Declares modules within the pack. For skin packs, use type 'skin_pack'.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Optional metadata about the pack including author names and license.

pack_behavior_pack_rest_of_file.title: Behavior Pack Content
pack_behavior_pack_rest_of_file.description: Defines the non-header content section of a behavior pack document.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description:
Properties:
• description
• language (string)
• type (string)
• uuid (string)
• version (string)
• entry (string)

language.description: The scripting language of this module (e.g., 'javascript').

entry.description: Script entry point for this behavior pack.
